videos.description:
On the final day of Kanwar Yatra 2025, a record-breaking number of Kanwariyas gathered in Haridwar to take a sacred dip in the River Ganga. Stunning drone visuals released by the Uttarakhand Information Department captured the massive crowd and spiritual fervor. Haridwar turned saffron as chants of "Bam Bam Bhole" echoed in the air. Watch this spectacular view of one of the largest religious gatherings in India.
